name: editlens
description: See each change Claude makes to your website, live: changed parts are highlighted, the chat and code appear beside the page, and you can use Claude from the page.

start.title: What /editlens does
start.description: Run Claude from the panel on your page (page control, the default), or only show Claude's work on the page (Manual). With Connect when Claude Code starts on, page control turns on when a session starts and your page opens.
options: Connect and turn on page control
start.default: Connect and turn on page control

permission_mode.title: Page control: permission mode
permission_mode.description: How often Claude asks before it acts when you use it from the page. This is the mode page control starts in. The menu under the panel's message box changes it for the current session only. Bypass is never the default.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How much effort Claude puts into each answer when you use it from the page, and in tasks it starts. More effort gives better answers, but takes longer and uses more of your plan. Auto uses the same level as Claude Code. Max is never saved: choose it on the page or with /editlens effort max, for the current session only.

safety_check.title: Safety check
safety_check.description: Ask before Claude replaces most of a file or removes EditLens from your app.

remote_tasks.title: Paired computers can run Claude here
remote_tasks.description: Lets a computer paired with this one give tasks to Claude here and start page control here. Permission questions from those tasks appear in the panel, and only you can allow them, in this computer's EditLens window. Off: the paired computer can only list its tasks and copy files from this project.

paired_answers.title: Paired computers can answer questions here
paired_answers.description: Lets a computer that joined this one (/editlens join) allow or deny Claude's permission questions here, in this computer's EditLens window opened through the pairing. Only questions about the paired project. Only this computer can turn it on. Off: you answer on this computer.

task_account.title: Run paired computers' tasks as
task_account.description: Auto: on Linux, when Claude Code runs as root, tasks from a paired computer run as the normal account editlens, after you set it up with /editlens task-user. Without that account, they run as root and say so. Root (unsafe): every task runs as root and can change anything on this computer. It turns on only after you allow it in this computer's EditLens window.

tasks_at_once.title: Tasks at once
tasks_at_once.description: How many tasks from paired computers run on this computer at the same time, 1 to 8. More tasks wait. Each running task uses about 0.3–0.5 GB of memory and uses your plan's limits. A change applies to the next task that starts.

subagent_copies.title: Subagents work in their own copy
subagent_copies.description: In a git project, each subagent that can change files works in its own copy of the project (a git worktree), so agents can't overwrite each other's changes. Its changes are added to your project when Claude merges them, or when you select Merge in the panel.

permission_glow.title: Highlight when Claude waits for you
permission_glow.description: Highlights the permissions button on the page while a question waits for your answer. It never moves when your computer is set to reduce motion.

highlight.title: Highlight changes on the page
highlight.description: Highlights the changed parts of the page for a moment.

hover_code.title: Show code on hover
hover_code.description: Shows the old and new code beside a changed part of the page when you move the pointer over it. Select the card to keep it open.

pick_box.title: Message box next to what you pick
pick_box.description: After you select something on the page, a small box opens next to it for a note. Add puts the note in the panel's message box, where you send it. Off: you type in the panel.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.description: Where your voice is turned into text when you use the mic. On this device: on your computer only. Allow online: the browser may send the audio to its maker. Off: no mic button.

follow_page.title: Follow: go to the page being changed
follow_page.description: When Claude changes a file shown on another page of your app, your page goes to that page.

expand_code_view.title: Expand the code view for new requests
expand_code_view.description: When the code view is made smaller to a narrow bar, it opens again for the first change of each new request.

wait.title: Wait for page messages
wait.description: After Claude finishes, it waits a few minutes for a message typed on the page. Terminal sessions only.

line_above_prompt.title: Line above the prompt
line_above_prompt.description: Shows the EditLens status line above Claude Code's prompt.

theme.title: Panel colors
theme.description: Light, Dark, or Auto. Auto uses the page's own colors, or your computer's if the page has none.

text_size.title: Panel text size
text_size.description: Text size in the panel and the code view.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: The code editor that Open starts, in the file menu of the code view and in More on a change card. None hides Open. Copy path and Copy code still work.

auto_connect.title: Connect when Claude Code starts
auto_connect.description: Connects your page when a session starts, so you don't need to enter /editlens first. Nothing in your project changes.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port the EditLens server uses on this computer. Change it only if 4317 is in use. The change applies after you restart Claude Code.
